title: dianthus scaber subsp. toletanus
intro: Dianthus scaber subsp. toletanus, commonly known as the Kashmir Pink or Toletan Pink, is a plant species in the carnation family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation and pain. The health benefits of Dianthus scaber subsp. toletanus include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
